title: On 3d Quantum Trace Maps
summary: A 3d quantum trace map is a homomorphism from the skein module of an ideally triangulated 3-manifold to its quantum gluing module that quantizes the classical trace map. There are two constructions of such maps, one by Garoufalidis and Yu in [GY], and the other by Panitch and Park in [PP1]. However, the relationship between these two constructions was unknown. We propose a third construction of the 3d quantum trace map which agrees with the one given by Garoufalidis and Yu, and extends to certain types of manifolds with ideally triangulated boundaries.
